sub_parameters.name: Name
sub_parameters.description:
The filter name. Valid values:

- Type: The notice type.

- ServiceId: The service ID.

- ServiceName: The service name. Fuzzy search is supported. The format for a fuzzy search is \*xxx\*.

- Category: The notice category.

- Severity: The severity level.

- NoticeId: The O\&M notice ID.

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page. Maximum value: 100. Default value: 20.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The query token. Set the value to the NextToken value returned in the last API call.
